reason: Certified for exact Block Visibility 3.7.1 on single-site WordPress, bounded to the block_visibility_settings option and visibility_preset rows whose control_sets contain only the reviewed reference-free controls. Native target behavior proves the migrated settings and entity-free preset hide and restore a target-local block. blockVisibility remains explicitly unsupported on every block because it carries conditionally-typed entity ids that the engine cannot rebind; reference-bearing preset controls and absent-row default completion likewise refuse. The adapter makes no claim for those surfaces, multisite, or plugin-specific deletion.

unsupported.reason: WPrism v1 refuses multisite before policy load, so this single-site adapter makes no network claim.

blockVisibility reaches every registered block and nests entity ids at paths whose kind depends on a sibling field. block_attrs binds one top-level key per exact block name over a closed {int,int[]} value vocabulary, so no declaration can rebind them. Declared unsupported on all 115 blocks that can carry it; capture refuses the moment authored content actually holds one. tools/engine-gaps.json records the demand as any_block_structured_attribute_reference_paths.

The visibility_preset meta key control_sets repeats the same conditionally-typed reference structure. The interpreter admits a control set only when every control in it is on a reviewed reference-free allowlist and refuses anything else by name. The allowlist direction is required, not stylistic: WooCommerce keeps its product id in a rule's subField rather than its value, and userRole carries restrictedUsers user ids in one of its modes, so a field-name denylist could never match either.
unsupported.surface: post_meta.control_sets controls outside the reviewed allowlist

unsupported.reason: block_visibility_settings is absent until the first save, and the plugin publishes its defaults only through register_setting() on rest_api_init/admin_init, which a capture process does not fire. There is no in-process way to read them from the plugin, so an absent row captures as absence rather than as a hardcoded copy of its defaults.
